title: Say hello to Project Tango!
summary: Google ATAP's short 2014 introduction to Project Tango, a mobile device effort to give phones and tablets a human-scale understanding of space and motion. It pitches ideas like indoor navigation and games that interact with your physical space.
why: HN references it as a demo of Project Tango's computer vision, including its use of monocular structure from motion.

quote.text: 19 second mark shows they are using monocular structure from motion.
